builds.name: Maximum Debuffer
builds.desc: This Takumi mostly serves a support role for use on a team with Gunnthra, while also being a solid attacking unit himself. The use of this Takumi is to go in and kill/seriously injure one unit and cause a -7/-7/-7/-7 debuff to all surrounding units within 2 spaces, which would make them easy pickings with Gunnthra's Blizzard.

builds.name: I Hate Ivs
builds.desc:
Just the build to use if you only manage to pull the worst Ivs possible.Either you wanna push to try to make up for the
lack of attack or just go full defense.You could even take Close counter if you run close defense as your seal to make up for sturdy blow.Infantry Pulse will only if you're on a team with glass cannon like Delthea or bow lyn.This build will work incredibly well when paired with a buffing dancer who can really push his stats to their limits such as Performing arts Azura and New Years Azura.

builds.name: Easing Speed Bane
builds.desc: A build to ease the speed bane some NY Takumi may suffer and not being able to pull for another one. Threaten Speed to be able to double even more, Life and Death to get more Speed. Fury would possibly also be an option but will cause continous damage. B Skill is flexible.

builds.name: Support Pineapple
builds.desc: A supportive Takumi designed to be paired with my Eternal Betrayal Build for the Fallen Heroes Takumi. For making the Ultimate Team of Pineapples!
